title: LK Map Adapter Capability V1 (DRAFT)
description: DRAFT declaration of what an external-tool adapter supports against the LK Map Document/Bundle contract. Pending A0 sign-off; see docs/A0-MAP-CONTRACT-DRAFT.md §2 and ADR-0002 '서로 다른 세 가지 round-trip'. An adapter must not claim capabilities it does not implement; saving an LK sidecar alone is not source-writeback.

import.description: external source -> LK read (geometry, hierarchy, transform, coordinate metadata, known semantic binding).

reimport.description: 3-way compare of a new source revision against the previous normalized base + web edits.

bundleRead.description: read an LK Map Bundle. Bundle round-trip is the required contract for every supported adapter.

sourceWriteback.description: LK -> external source. 'none' = read-only adapter; 'semantic' = route/area/goal/facility to a sidecar/override the tool reads; 'structural' = supported level/floor/wall/door/asset transform subset written to the source.

derivedExport.description: non-authoritative derived runtime outputs the adapter can produce.

visualRoundTrip.description: full preservation of engine material/shader/Blueprint/MonoBehaviour/physics/sensor. Not guaranteed by the contract; typically false.

derivedReverseImport.description: recovering an authored scene from GLB/occupancy is forbidden; always false.
